findings.finding: Open, Low. tools/skills/change.cjs:66-71 reads only headers that start with "+++ b/". With core.quotePath=false, git still quotes a path that holds a double quote, a backslash, or a control character, and prints +++ "b/a\"b.js" (review-evidence/quote-probe.log). parseAddedLines then sets current to null and drops every added line of that file, so no addedLines rule fires for it. Scenario: a file named a"b.ts adds a fetch call, and the fetch-timeout lesson is not required. 8113bfe fixed the spaced-path instance of this pattern, but not the quoted one.
findings.open: The reviewed range does not fix it.
